eval.description: Google fairness eval of zero-shot translation into English when the source encodes gender unambiguously. An automated scorer checks personal pronouns in the English output for potential misgendering. Cards report accuracy overall and on "he" / "she" slices (and worst-case language or eval-set slices). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model uses the correct gendered pronouns when it translates clearly gendered text into English.

versions.changes: As reported in Flan-T5 and PaLM 2 cards; eval sets include gender-sets and late-binding style cases.

scores.description: Whether the English translation avoids pronoun errors that can cause misgendering harm.

metrics.description: Share of translations without potential misgendering errors. Higher is better.
